description.zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
description.en: The name of the agent account (agent logon name).
The acid in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique ID of the client request, which is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate this ID.
The connId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

description.zh: 入呼后，websocket中的holdConnId（ 仅在双步转时传入）
description.en: The holdConnId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for a two-step transfer.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
The jobId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.
